resources.string: Compare dated paths from Key Heights and Key Events alongside the current sky.
Save named Personal Moments with a date and an optional time.
Import and export Personal Moments separately, or include active comparisons in a Location.
Dated paths are grouped under their object and shown in chronological order.
The Observatory menu gives quick access to paths, key points and personal moments.
Photos and panoramas show path names and include active comparisons in their exports.
